findings.message: At launch speed 9 the top of the ball is at y=60 and the callout box is at y=40 to 96. That is inside the lane (y=34 to 266), so I found no clipping. I can't judge overlap or clipping without pixels.

At the endpoint the ball is back at base with v = -5, and the Motion arrow points down and is 60 long. That matches the traces. The state word 'Returned to base' sits beside the callout 'Moving downward'. This is acceptable.
